source_claim: The Pop-Up Story special feature's official character illustration index names Emelia Pris, Ledo Vassar, Selim Spark, Ziz Glaver, and Yuuri Lessen among the game's characters. Square Enix's official product announcement identifies Pop-Up Story: The Magic Book and the Academy of the Sacred Tree as its game title and copyright.
notes: The special page labels itself as a Pop-Up Story illustration gallery, includes exact character names, and displays the Square Enix copyright. The official Square Enix launch announcement identifies the game's complete title and official website: https://www.jp.square-enix.com/company/ja/news/2015/html/20151029_01.html. Luke Venus and Shiroe Adele remain separate partial residuals.
